is: The voice a place's people play, worked out from its design, never a list of places or people (score/stages/sound): wherever the place's picked design stands people (data/people/rows.json), `people` (a sound of data/sound/sounds.json) plays on its first person, at /<place>/Characters/<name>. None is named while the old sound shelf is withdrawn (owner, 2026-10-21: all old stuff is retired): a place with people is a voice gap until a fresh take is picked and named here. What the people say (a speech, a radio call) is not in the design, so no rule here picks it.
